issue.title: UTabs loses the active tab on page reload when driven by the URL hash
issue.author: aravind
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.4.0
- Nuxt: 3.14.0

### Description

I bind `UTabs` to the URL hash. Clicking a tab updates the hash and highlights it, but after a reload on `/#pricing` no tab is highlighted.
